title: Nonnegativity of the Hedge distribution
statement: Fix $N \ge 1$ experts and $T$ rounds, a learning rate $\eta \in \bbr$, and a loss sequence $\ell$. For every time $t$ and every expert $i$, the Hedge distribution is nonnegative, that is, $p_t(i) \ge 0$.
replaced:
For any $\eta$, loss sequence $\ell$, time $t$, and expert $i$, the Hedge
distribution satisfies $p_t(i) \ge 0$.
